en.headline: ITC backs three smart-factory projects under acceleration scheme
en.dek: The Innovation and Technology Commission said a vetting committee had supported in principle three applications covering health products, semiconductor memory and construction prefabrication.
body: The Innovation and Technology Commission announced on Thursday that the New Industrialisation Vetting Committee under the Innovation and Technology Fund had supported in principle three applications under the New Industrialisation Acceleration Scheme.

Huayao International, a subsidiary of Jiuhua Huayuan Pharmaceutical, plans health-supplement production lines with an estimated total investment of more than HK$240 million and expected scheme funding of about HK$80 million. HKIC International Technology plans a line for semiconductor memory modules and storage devices, with investment of more than HK$210 million and expected funding of about HK$70 million. Hong Kong Smart Construction Industry Park, a subsidiary of China State Construction International Holdings, plans facilities for steel-rebar prefabrication and multi-trade integrated mechanical, electrical and plumbing processing, with investment of nearly HK$390 million and expected funding of about HK$130 million.

The Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry, Professor Sun Dong, said the three projects covered life-and-health technology and advanced manufacturing and demonstrated the government's commitment to new industrialisation in Hong Kong.

The scheme funds companies in designated strategic industries that commit at least HK$100 million to new smart production facilities in Hong Kong. Support is on a one-to-two matching basis between the government and the enterprise, with a funding cap of HK$200 million per company. The government also provides extra support for hiring research talent and technical staff. Applications are accepted year-round, the commission said.

zh.headline: 創科署原則支持三宗新型工業加速計劃申請
zh.dek: 創新科技署表示，評審委員會原則上支持三宗申請，涵蓋保健品、半導體記憶體及建造預製加工設施。
body: 創新科技署星期四宣布，創新及科技基金下的新型工業評審委員會，已原則上支持三宗「新型工業加速計劃」申請。
九華華源藥業旗下華藥國際擬建立保健品生產線，總預算投資超過2.4億元，預計計劃資助約8,000萬元。港芯國際科技擬建立半導體記憶體模組及存儲裝置生產線，總預算投資超過2.1億元，預計資助約7,000萬元。中國建築國際集團旗下香港智能建造產業園擬建立鋼筋預製及機電裝備合成加工設施，總預算投資接近3.9億元，預計資助約1.3億元。
創新科技及工業局局長孫東表示，三個項目涵蓋生命健康科技和先進製造科技，展現特區政府推動香港新型工業化的承擔。
加速計劃面向生命健康科技、人工智能與數據科學，以及先進製造與新能源科技等策略性產業，企業須承諾在港投放不少於1億元設立新智能生產設施。資助以政府一、企業二的比例配對，每家企業上限2億元，另可獲額外資助聘用研究人才及技術人員。計劃全年接受申請。
